summary: M0 model-only verdict: ESCALATE @ 1.00. Lab-admin account accessed repeatedly from a foreign Cloud VPS IP (45.142.10.9, Frankfurt) via a flagged vulnerable VPN appliance. MFA was approved once, then subsequent sign-ins succeeded without MFA prompts, consistent with possible session hijack or MFA bypass after initial compromise. No device identity, no mail activity, and no confirmed malicious action beyond the sign-ins themselves. The combination of high-privilege account, vulnerable appliance exposure, and anomalous geolocation/ASN is insufficient to confirm account takeover but warrants immediate human review.
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
